Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.dto

Record Class ArticleResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.dto.ArticleResponse
Record Components:
articleId - Stable article identifier.
title - Article headline.
url - Canonical article URL as a string.
topic - Feed source name or search keyword used to categorize this article.
author - Byline; null if not determinable.
sourceName - Human-readable feed label (e.g. "PubMed AI Healthcare").
sourceTier - Harvest tier: "ACADEMIC", "REGULATORY", or "INDUSTRY".
sourceWeight - Baseline relevance multiplier [0.0, 1.0].
publishedAt - Publication timestamp; null if not determinable.
public record ArticleResponse(String articleId, String title, String url, String topic, String author, String sourceName, String sourceTier, double sourceWeight, Instant publishedAt) extends Record
Response DTO representing a single persisted news article.

Returned by GET /api/v1/articles?topic={topic}&limit={limit}. The url field is serialized as a plain string (the underlying domain type is java.net.URI, converted in the controller).
